Name: Stardrop - Native MacOS
Author: kautsaralbaa
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]It delivers a first-class Mac desktop experience: instantaneous cold starts, native Apple trackpad physics, system menu bar integration, and zero external runtime dependencies (no .NET or Mono runtime required).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
---

[size=4][b]Why a Native Mac Edition?[/b][/size]

While the cross-platform version of Stardrop is functional, it runs on the Avalonia UI framework, which renders controls onto an emulated canvas.

Stardrop macOS Native bridges this gap by offering:
- Pure AppKit and SwiftUI components adhering strictly to Apple Human Interface Guidelines.
- Native Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel (x86_64) binaries.
- Fluid trackpad scrolling, elastic overscroll bounce, and subpixel font antialiasing.
- Mod deletion integrated directly with the macOS Trash Bin rather than permanent deletion.
- Standard macOS keyboard shortcuts and window sheets.

---

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

[b]1. Direct Mod Archive Installation (Drag and Drop)[/b]
- Drag and drop `.zip`, `.7z`, `.rar`, `.tar.gz` archives or uncompressed folders directly into the app window.
- Manual file selection via Command+O or the toolbar button.
- Automatically traverses folder trees to discover nested `manifest.json` mod files.
- Preserves existing `config.json` files when reinstalling or updating mods.

[b]2. Mod Separator System (MO2-Style)[/b]
- Organize mod lists using visual separator banners inspired by Mod Organizer 2.
- Collapse or expand sections to keep large mod lists manageable.
- Reorder separators and move mods between sections.
- Bulk enable or disable all mods within a specific separator.

[b]3. Batch Selection and Fast Keyboard Navigation[/b]
- Select contiguous mod ranges using Shift+Click or Shift+Up/Down arrows.
- Multi-select non-contiguous mods using Command+Click.
- Select all visible mods using Command+A.
- Press Spacebar to instantly toggle single or multiple selected mods.
- Search and filter by mod name, author, or update status without keyboard shortcuts interfering with text fields.

[b]4. Mod Deletion with Dependency Safety Warnings[/b]
- Delete mods from the right-click context menu or the sidebar inspector.
- Built-in Dependency Guard: checks whether a mod is a required dependency for any currently enabled mods and displays a confirmation warning before deletion.
- Safe deletion: deleted folders are moved to the macOS Trash Bin (~/.Trash).
- Core SMAPI components (ConsoleCommands, SaveBackup, ErrorHandler) are protected from accidental removal.

[b]5. Nexus Mods Integration and Endorsements[/b]
- Connect your Nexus Mods personal API key.
- Displays account details and membership tier (Free / Premium).
- View endorsement status and endorse or abstain directly from within the application.
- Encrypted locally in Notion.json using AES-256-CBC obscurity, fully compatible with the original C# Stardrop format.

[b]6. Profile Management and SMAPI Launching[/b]
- Create, duplicate, and switch between isolated mod profiles.
- Staged launching: selected mods are symlinked into the game directory during launch without duplicating gigabytes of files on disk.
- Launch the game with SMAPI directly using Command+R.

[b]7. In-App Config Editor and Diagnostics[/b]
- Edit mod `config.json` files natively with real-time JSON syntax validation.
- One-click shortcuts to open the mod directory, SMAPI error logs, and data folders in Finder.

---

[b]100% Compatibility with Original Stardrop[/b]

Stardrop macOS Native was engineered to share the exact same configuration schemas and directory structure as the official cross-platform build:

- Location: `~/Library/Application Support/Stardrop/Data/`
- Shared Files: `Settings.json`, `Profiles/*.json`, and `Cache/Notion.json`.

You can switch back and forth between Stardrop C# and Stardrop macOS Native without losing your profiles, settings, or mod configurations.

---

[b]Requirements and System Compatibility[/b]

- Operating System: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0 (Sequoia), or later.
- Hardware: Apple Silicon (M-series chips) and Intel x86_64.
- Game: Stardew Valley (Steam or GOG release).
- Modding API: SMAPI installed.

---

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download `Stardrop-<version>-macOS.zip` from the Files tab.
2. Double-click the downloaded archive to extract it.
3. Double-click the downloaded disk image to open it.
4. Drag the **Stardrop** icon into your **Applications** folder.
5. Launch Stardrop from Launchpad, Spotlight, or Applications.

---

[b]Keyboard Shortcuts Quick Reference[/b]

- `Space`: Toggle selected mod(s) enabled or disabled
- `Up` / `Down`: Navigate through the mod list
- `Shift + Up` / `Shift + Down`: Expand or contract selection range
- `Command + A`: Select all visible mods
- `Command + O`: Install mod from archive (.zip, .7z, .rar, .tar.gz) or folder
- `Command + R`: Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI
- `Command + U`: Check for mod updates
- `Command + ,`: Open Settings / Preferences
- `Shift + Command + N`: Open Nexus Mods Account window
- `Shift + Command + S`: Create new mod separator
- `Escape`: Dismiss active sheet or modal
